root.title: Welcome
root.message: Hi! 👋 Welcome to Orbq. What would you like to know?

platform_overview.title: About Orbq
platform_overview.message: Orbq is an AI-powered Lead Automation Platform that helps businesses capture, manage, nurture, and convert leads from multiple communication channels.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.message: Every conversation is captured the moment it comes in, an AI Agent reads intent and replies instantly, qualified leads sync straight to your CRM, and automation handles the follow-up — end to end, without anyone chasing it manually.

who_uses_it.title: Who It's For
who_uses_it.message: D2C and e-commerce brands, SaaS companies, real estate and education consultancies, agencies juggling multiple client inboxes, and enterprises with high inbound volume across WhatsApp, Instagram, and email all run on Orbq.

problems_solved.title: Problems Solved
problems_solved.message: Leads get lost across scattered tools, first response takes hours instead of seconds, teams have no unified view of a conversation, CRM entry is manual, and after-hours inquiries go unanswered. Orbq fixes all five.

why_choose.title: Why Orbq
why_choose.message: Teams switch because first response drops from hours to seconds, setup takes a few hours instead of six weeks, and every channel — not just one — reports into a single pipeline.

features.title: Features
features.message: Everything you need to run your whole funnel from one place — capture, qualify, automate, and analyze, without stitching together five different tools.

lead_capture.title: Lead Capture
lead_capture.message: Orbq listens across every channel your leads actually use and pulls every conversation into one unified inbox the moment it arrives.

ch_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
ch_whatsapp.message: Connected via the official WhatsApp Business API — the same channel your customers already use every day.

wa_api.title: WhatsApp API
wa_api.message: Official Business API integration, no green-screen QR hacks. Send template messages, media, and buttons, fully within Meta's compliance rules.

wa_auto_reply.title: Automated Replies
wa_auto_reply.message: The AI Agent answers FAQs, pricing questions, and product queries instantly using your own knowledge base — no waiting for a human.

wa_inbox.title: Shared Inbox
wa_inbox.message: Every WhatsApp thread lands in the Unified Inbox, so your whole team sees the same conversation history instead of one person's personal phone.

wa_qualify.title: Lead Qualification
wa_qualify.message: Before a conversation reaches sales, the AI Agent scores intent and budget signals, so reps only pick up warm, ready-to-buy leads.

ch_instagram.title: Instagram
ch_instagram.message: DMs, story replies, and comments are all pulled into the same inbox as everything else — nothing sits in a separate app.

ig_dm.title: Instagram DMs
ig_dm.message: The AI Agent auto-replies to story replies and comments in real time, so an engaged follower never waits for a manual response.

ig_capture.title: Lead Capture Forms
ig_capture.message: Bio-link and ad-driven forms feed leads straight into Orbq, pre-tagged with the campaign they came from.

ig_handoff.title: Human Handoff
ig_handoff.message: Anything outside the AI's confidence range is flagged and handed to a human with full context attached.

ch_messenger.title: Facebook Messenger
ch_messenger.message: Messenger threads share the same inbox, quick-reply menus, and handoff rules as every other channel.

fb_shared.title: Shared Inbox
fb_shared.message: Every Messenger conversation is visible to the whole team, with history preserved even after handoff.

fb_quick.title: Quick Replies & Menus
fb_quick.message: Structured menus guide common questions (pricing, availability, support) without needing a human to type.

fb_handoff.title: Human Handoff
fb_handoff.message: Sensitive or complex threads escalate to a human agent automatically, with the full chat log attached.

ch_webchat.title: Website Chat
ch_webchat.message: An embeddable chat widget on your own site, backed by the same AI Agents and knowledge base as every other channel.

wc_widget.title: Embeddable Widget
wc_widget.message: Drop a single script tag on your site and the widget matches your brand — no iframe, no third-party look.

wc_kb.title: Knowledge Base Answers
wc_kb.message: Visitor questions are answered from your own product docs and pricing pages, grounded in what's actually true.

wc_route.title: Smart Routing to Sales
wc_route.message: High-intent visitors are scored and routed to a live rep the moment they show buying signals.

ch_email.title: Email
ch_email.message: Sales and support inboxes are parsed, tagged, and synced automatically — no more manually copying threads into a CRM.

em_parse.title: Inbox Parsing
em_parse.message: Incoming emails are automatically classified as sales inquiries, support requests, or noise.

em_template.title: Template Replies
em_template.message: Common questions get an instant, on-brand reply while the AI Agent drafts a fuller response for review.

em_thread.title: Thread Sync to CRM
em_thread.message: Every email thread attaches to the right contact record automatically, no forwarding required.

ch_sms.title: SMS
ch_sms.message: Two-way text messaging that plugs into the same automation and compliance rules as your other channels.

sms_auto.title: Two-Way Automation
sms_auto.message: Automated replies and reminders go out by SMS, with a human able to jump into the same thread anytime.

sms_optout.title: Opt-Out Compliance
sms_optout.message: STOP/opt-out handling is automatic and enforced, so campaigns stay compliant without manual list management.

sms_broadcast.title: Broadcast Campaigns
sms_broadcast.message: SMS can also be used for one-to-many broadcasts — see the Broadcasts section for details.

ch_voice.title: Voice
ch_voice.message: Picks up inbound calls in real time with sub-second latency, qualifies the caller against the same rules your other agents use, then books the callback or warm-transfers to a human.

voice_answer.title: Real-Time Answering
voice_answer.message: Calls are answered instantly, 24/7, with natural, low-latency conversational AI — no hold music.

voice_qualify.title: Caller Qualification
voice_qualify.message: The Voice Agent applies the exact same qualification rules as your chat channels, so scoring stays consistent everywhere.

voice_transfer.title: Callback & Warm Transfer
voice_transfer.message: Complex calls get warm-transferred to a human with full context, or a callback is booked automatically if no one's free.

ai_agents.title: AI Agents
ai_agents.message: Four dedicated AI Agents run your entire lifecycle — each one specialized instead of one generic bot trying to do everything.

marketing_agent.title: Marketing AI Agent
marketing_agent.message: Monitors campaigns, answers incoming queries from social channels using approved product guidelines, and triggers drip schedules to revive inactive cold leads.

mk_nurture.title: Cold Lead Nurturing
mk_nurture.message: Leads that go quiet are automatically re-engaged with drip schedules, instead of sitting untouched in a spreadsheet.

mk_social.title: Social Query Handling
mk_social.message: Incoming questions on Instagram and Facebook are answered using your approved product guidelines — consistent messaging, no copy-paste.

sales_agent.title: Sales AI Agent
sales_agent.message: Evaluates user intent and matches lead profiles against custom parameters. Scores leads automatically and triggers live alerts or CRM routes.

sa_scoring.title: Live Lead Scoring
sa_scoring.message: Org size, budget, and channel are weighed automatically to produce a live Hot / Warm score for every lead — the same logic shown in our landing page score calculator.

sa_routing.title: Custom Routing Rules
sa_routing.message: Route leads by country, company size, budget intent, or any score the AI generates — defined visually, no code required.

sa_alerts.title: Real-Time Sales Alerts
sa_alerts.message: The moment a lead crosses your hot-lead threshold, the assigned rep gets notified instantly — no end-of-day report to wait for.

support_agent.title: Support AI Agent
support_agent.message: Handles post-sale inquiries, searches vector store libraries for product queries, and triggers manual team redirects if it detects unhappy customer sentiment.

sp_kb.title: Knowledge Base Search
sp_kb.message: Answers are grounded in your own product docs via an isolated vector store per organization — not a generic public model guess.

sp_sentiment.title: Sentiment Detection
sp_sentiment.message: Frustration or dissatisfaction in a message is detected automatically, and the conversation is flagged for a human before it escalates further.

sp_handoff.title: Human Escalation
sp_handoff.message: Any unhappy or unresolved thread routes to your support team with full conversation history attached — no re-explaining.

voice_agent.title: Voice AI Agent
voice_agent.message: Picks up inbound calls in real time with sub-second latency, qualifies the caller against the same rules your other agents use, then books the callback or warm-transfers to a human.

vc_latency.title: Sub-Second Latency
vc_latency.message: Calls are answered and responded to in real time — the conversation feels natural, not like talking to an IVR menu.

vc_qualify.title: Live Caller Qualification
vc_qualify.message: The same scoring rules used across chat and email apply on the call, so a hot lead is flagged consistently no matter the channel.

vc_transfer.title: Warm Transfer to Human
vc_transfer.message: If a human is needed, the call transfers with full context already summarized — or a callback is booked automatically if no one's available.

crm.title: CRM
crm.message: Orbq sits in front of your existing CRM — HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and more — instantly capturing, qualifying, and syncing leads with full chat transcripts, no manual entry.

crm_sync.title: Bi-Directional Sync
crm_sync.message: Updates flow both ways — a status change in your CRM reflects back in Orbq, and vice versa, so nothing goes stale.

crm_pipeline.title: Pipeline Automation
crm_pipeline.message: Deals move stage automatically as qualification signals change, instead of a rep manually dragging cards.

crm_transcripts.title: Full Conversation History
crm_transcripts.message: Every deal carries its complete chat, email, and call history — so sales never has to ask a lead to repeat themselves.

workflow_automation.title: Workflow Automation
workflow_automation.message: A visual, no-code workflow builder lets you define exact rules — route by country, company size, budget signal, or any score the AI generates — without writing a line of code.

wf_builder.title: Visual Workflow Builder
wf_builder.message: Drag-and-drop nodes define your flow — no engineering ticket required to change a rule.

wf_rules.title: Custom Routing Rules
wf_rules.message: Route by country, company size, budget intent, or any AI-generated score — the same rules engine that powers Sales AI Agent routing.

wf_triggers.title: Automated Triggers
wf_triggers.message: Actions fire automatically on events like 'lead goes cold for 3 days' or 'score crosses 75' — no one has to watch a dashboard.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.message: Launch multi-channel campaigns — Instagram Story broadcasts, WhatsApp drip sequences, email nurtures — from one composer, and let the Marketing AI Agent monitor performance in real time.

cp_composer.title: Campaign Composer
cp_composer.message: Build a campaign once and target it across WhatsApp, Instagram, and email from a single screen.

cp_simulator.title: Broadcast Simulator
cp_simulator.message: Preview reach and conversion before you launch — like the 942-contact, 32.8% conversion Insta Story broadcast shown on our landing page.

cp_drip.title: Automated Drip Schedules
cp_drip.message: Cold or inactive leads are automatically re-engaged on a schedule you define, without manual follow-up.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.message: Send one-to-many messages across WhatsApp, SMS, and Instagram with delivery tracking, so you always know what landed and what converted.

bc_multichannel.title: Multi-Channel Sends
bc_multichannel.message: One broadcast, sent across WhatsApp, SMS, and Instagram simultaneously, each formatted for its channel.

bc_tracking.title: Delivery & Read Tracking
bc_tracking.message: Delivery, read, and reply status are tracked per recipient, per channel — no guessing what actually landed.

bc_segments.title: Audience Segments
bc_segments.message: Target broadcasts to segments built from lead score, channel, tags, or CRM stage — not just your whole list every time.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.message: Live dashboards track conversations autopiloted, median response time, CSAT, and pipeline generated — broken down by channel, so you always know what's working.

an_funnel.title: Funnel & Conversion Charts
an_funnel.message: Track the funnel from new conversation to AI-qualified to hot lead to won deal, with conversion rate at every stage.

an_channel.title: Channel Performance Breakdown
an_channel.message: See which channel — WhatsApp, Email, Web chat, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, or Voice — is actually driving pipeline, not just volume.

an_realtime.title: Real-Time Dashboards
an_realtime.message: Metrics like 82.6% conversations autopiloted, 3s median response time, and 4.8/5 CSAT update live, not on a nightly batch job.

security.title: Security
security.message: Every organization gets isolated, encrypted vector databases. Conversations and documents are encrypted at rest and in transit, and are never used to train public models.

sec_isolation.title: Isolated Vector DBs
sec_isolation.message: Each organization's knowledge base lives in its own isolated vector store — never mixed with another company's data.

sec_encryption.title: Encryption at Rest & Transit
sec_encryption.message: Documents, logs, and conversations are encrypted both while stored and while in transit between services.

sec_privacy.title: No Public Model Training
sec_privacy.message: Your company data is never used to train public models — it stays scoped to your organization, full stop.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.message: Orbq plugs into the tools your team already runs on — CRMs, comms channels, and workflow tools — instead of asking you to replace them.

int_crm.title: CRM Integrations
int_crm.message: HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zoho are supported out of the box — leads and full conversation transcripts sync automatically, no manual export or import.

int_comms.title: Channel Integrations
int_comms.message: WhatsApp Business API, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger, LinkedIn lead forms, Twilio Voice, Email, and SMS all connect natively.

int_dev.title: Developer & API Access
int_dev.message: Need something custom? A REST API and webhook layer let your engineering team push and pull lead data programmatically.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.message: Pricing is scoped to your channel mix and lead volume — not a flat per-seat fee — so talk to our team and we'll build a plan around what you actually need.

pr_scale.title: How Pricing Scales
pr_scale.message: Plans scale with lead volume, not team size — so a 5-person team and a 50-person team handling the same volume pay the same.

pr_trial.title: Free Trial
pr_trial.message: Most teams start with a live trial to see qualified leads flow in before ever talking numbers. Contact sales to get set up.

demo.title: Book a Demo
demo.message: Great choice! Book a live walkthrough and we'll show Orbq running on your actual use case — channels, CRM, and all.

contact_sales.title: Contact Sales
contact_sales.message: Our team typically replies within a few hours. Tell us your use case and we'll get you set up.

support.title: Support
support.message: Need help with something already set up? Our support team handles onboarding, integration issues, and account questions.

su_onboarding.title: Onboarding Help
su_onboarding.message: Our team can walk you through connecting your first channel and uploading your knowledge base — just email support and mention you're onboarding.

su_technical.title: Technical Issue
su_technical.message: For integration errors, sync failures, or anything not behaving as expected, email support with a screenshot and we'll dig in fast.

su_account.title: Account / Billing
su_account.message: For plan changes, invoices, or account access questions, email support and our team will loop in billing directly.
